title: BUG: AmazonBedrockServerModel Throw Error When calling DeepSeek R1: "text" field not found
author: khe-gh

comments.author: albertvillanova
comments.body:
Thanks for reporting, @khe-gh.

Please note that the issue with thinking messages was originally addressed in:
- #1632 

However, it seems the fix didn’t fully cover all model variations. 

We'll investigate further to ensure it works correctly for DeepSeek R1 as well.
